title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-01 04:35:15 最新章节：第911章 大夏皇朝来人
content_zh:
“外门弟子苏辰，对内门弟子叶凰儿强加非礼，违反门规，处罚废掉丹田，杖责一百，苏辰，你可有话说？”
太玄门，执法殿内，执法长老云长空厉声喝道。
周围数十名弟子也都齐刷刷的看向了执法大殿的中央位置的少年，目光中既有讥讽，又有嘲弄，不少女弟子的眼中则满是厌恶。
这是一名十六七岁、身材瘦削的黑衣少年。
少年浑身伤痕，脸上却满是坚毅之色，双目更是露出冷厉的光芒。
“我，无话可说。”
面对云长空的质问，黑衣少年苏辰没有辩解，只是冷声说道。
欲加之罪，何患无辞。
他与叶凰儿乃是青梅竹马，同为外门两大天才，只是叶凰儿被内门长老看重，加入内门，两人几月不见。
昨天叶凰儿约他去宗门的清幽小山，苏辰激动前去，想要跟叶凰儿好好倾诉自己的情谊，让叶凰儿等待自己一段时间，自己也一定能够前往内门，追上她的脚步。
但让苏辰没想到的是，清幽小山上的叶凰儿竟然衣衫不整，脸带血痕，哭哭啼啼，等苏辰慌乱的上前查看时，叶凰儿竟然一下子把苏辰拽倒在地，大呼非礼。
接着，几名内门弟子从竹林之中冲了出来，把苏辰打伤，并擒入执法堂。
此时苏辰就算再蠢，又岂能不明白自己是遭到了叶凰儿的陷害。
云长空微微一怔，没想到苏辰会丝毫不进行辩解，不过这也省了他的麻烦。
“好，既然无话可说，那就行刑吧。”
他的嘴角扬起了一丝冷笑，轻哼一声，一股强大的威势，便是朝着苏辰身上镇压而去！
轰！
顿时，苏辰身上仿佛是压着了一座大山！
咯吱咯吱！
苏辰的骨骼在这压力之下，都是响了起来。

苏辰双目猩红，拳头更是紧紧握住，却强硬的撑起身体，抬起头，死死的盯着云长空。
一缕缕鲜血，从他嘴角之中渗出。
“还不行刑！”
云长空勃然大怒，对一旁的执法弟子喝道。
那名执法弟子目光闪烁，犹豫片刻，咽了一口唾沫，忽然走上前，一掌狠狠轰在了苏辰的丹田之上。
啵！
一声轻响，苏辰的丹田破碎，剧烈的疼痛从丹田位置席卷全身，整个人卸掉了所有力气，无力趴在了地上。
苏辰双目猩红，双拳死死的攥起。
恨！
自己本是天才，丹田被破，便是沦为废人，从此，就是任人欺辱的命运。
而他，却根本没有办法反抗。
“杖责一百，从今往后，苏辰再也不是太玄门的弟子，也决不允许再踏入太玄门半步。”
云长空冷笑一声。
嘭！
嘭！
嘭！
两根木棍被执法弟子抡圆打在苏辰身上，发出声声闷响。
一百杖下去，苏辰皮开肉绽，身体之上满是鲜血，但苏辰却始终咬牙，并未叫出一声。
两名执法弟子拉着苏辰的两条腿，在地上拖出一道狰狞的血痕，一路拖着走出执法殿，在太玄门无数弟子或是惊愕或是怜悯的目光中，穿过整个太玄门，来到了山门之前。
嘭！
content_en:
"Outer sect disciple Su Chen, forcibly molested inner sect disciple Ye Huang'er, violated sect rules, and was punished by destroying the Dantian and a hundred rods. Su Chen, do you have anything to say?"
In Taixuanmen, in the Law Enforcement Hall, the law enforcement elder Yun Changkong shouted sharply.
Dozens of disciples around him also looked at the young man in the center of the law enforcement hall. Their eyes were full of sarcasm and ridicule, and the eyes of many female disciples were full of disgust.
This is a slender boy in black, about sixteen or seventeen years old.
The young man was covered in scars, but his face was full of perseverance, and his eyes shone coldly.
"I have nothing to say."
Facing Yun Changkong's questioning, Su Chen, a young man in black, did not defend himself, but said coldly.
If you want to impose a crime, there is no need to hesitate.
He and Ye Huang'er were childhood sweethearts, and they were both two great geniuses in the outer sect. However, Ye Huang'er was valued by the elders of the inner sect and joined the inner sect. They had not seen each other for several months.
Yesterday, Ye Huang'er asked him to go to the quiet hill of the sect. Su Chen went there excitedly, wanting to talk to Ye Huang'er about his friendship. He asked Ye Huang'er to wait for him for a while, and he would definitely be able to go to the inner sect and catch up with her.
But what Su Chen didn't expect was that Ye Huang'er on the quiet hill was disheveled, with blood on her face, and was crying. When Su Chen came forward to check in a panic, Ye Huang'er suddenly dragged Su Chen to the ground and shouted, "I'm rude."
Then, several inner disciples rushed out from the bamboo forest, injured Su Chen, and captured him into the law enforcement hall.
No matter how stupid Su Chen was at this time, how could he not understand that he had been framed by Ye Huang'er.
Yun Changkong was slightly startled. He did not expect that Su Chen would not defend himself at all, but this also saved him trouble.
"Okay, since I have nothing to say, let's carry out the execution."
A sneer appeared at the corner of his mouth, he snorted, and a powerful force was directed towards Su Chen to suppress him!
boom!
Suddenly, Su Chen seemed to be pressed by a huge mountain!
Creak, creak, creak!
Su Chen's bones rang under the pressure.
Su Chen's eyes were scarlet, and his fists were clenched tightly, but he stood up forcefully, raised his head, and stared at Yun Changkong.
Streams of blood seeped out from the corners of his mouth.
"Not yet execution!"
Yun Changkong was furious and shouted to the law enforcement disciples on the side.
The law enforcement disciple's eyes flickered, he hesitated for a moment, swallowed, suddenly stepped forward, and struck Su Chen's Dantian with a palm.
Bo!
With a soft sound, Su Chen's Dantian shattered, and severe pain swept through his body from the Dantian. He lost all his strength and fell to the ground helplessly.
Su Chen's eyes were scarlet and he clenched his fists tightly.
hatred!
He was originally a genius, but if his Dantian was broken, he would become a useless person. From then on, he would be the fate of being bullied by others.
But he had no way to resist.
"One hundred rod punishments. From now on, Su Chen will no longer be a disciple of Taixuan Sect, and will never be allowed to step into Taixuan Sect again."
Yun Changkong sneered.
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Two wooden sticks were hit on Su Chen's body by the law enforcement disciples, making a muffled sound.
After a hundred strokes of the stick, Su Chen's skin and flesh were torn open, and his body was covered with blood. However, Su Chen gritted his teeth and did not scream.
The two law enforcement disciples pulled Su Chen's legs, dragging a ferocious bloodstain on the ground, dragging them all the way out of the law enforcement hall. Under the eyes of countless Taixuanmen disciples who were either shocked or pitiful, they passed through the entire Taixuanmen and arrived in front of the mountain gate.
Bang!
